events.old_value: Our subscription revenue depends on customer retention, and we may experience slower growth if customers reduce usage of the Northstar platform. Customer budgets for technology products may change during economic downturns, which could reduce demand for our services and affect revenue growth. Interruptions at these facilities could reduce service availability, trigger contractual penalties, and damage our relationships with enterprise customers.
